import pandas as pd
cols = list(df.columns)
# identify columns

approved_col = 'approved'
defaulted_col = 'defaulted'
res = df[[arm_col, approved_col, defaulted_col]].copy()
res['rate'] = res[defaulted_col] / res[approved_col]
res_sorted = res.sort_values('rate', ascending=True)
row = res_sorted.iloc[0]
print(row[arm_col], row[defaulted_col], row[approved_col], row['rate'])
